caption:
Snowboarders ask us the same question every year: is Hokkaido tree skiing any good on a board?

This is the answer. Birch forest, waist-deep, no flat run-outs if you know where to drop in. We plan the lines so nobody has to unstrap and walk.

Roughly a third of our guests ride boards. If that's you, send us a message and we'll tell you which weeks suit best.
